payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and techniques used for feature extraction from text, particularly in the context of Named Entity Recognition (NER) and text classification.

claims.text: Features extracted from text include keywords and indicators derived from clusters of related texts, which are used as input features for classifiers.
Text features are extracted using a sparse vectorizer, specifically the Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) method, for text classification tasks.
A bag-of-words technique is employed to extract features from text data for training classifiers in Named Entity Recognition.
